- Coverage claimed: C2 collision damage. Repair quote: €1,200.
- Attachments listed in the email: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 collision damage is listed in the Policy Schedule, and no excluded or unlisted coverage was shown. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 2)
- **Reporting:** The claim was reported 2 days after the incident, within the 5-day limit. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 4.1)
- **Possible exclusions:** The email shows no alcohol, drugs, racing, intent or wear-related cause, so no exclusion is flagged. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 3)
- **Deductible:** The insured was not at fault and the third party is identified, so the not-at-fault waiver applies and no deductible is charged. The young-driver surcharge does not apply because the licence is more than 3 years old. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 5.2 and 5.3)
- **Assessor:** The repair cost of €1,200 is at or below €1,500, so an independent assessor is not required. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 6.1)
- **Payout:** Compensation is the repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. This gives €1,200 minus €0. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 6.2)
- **Referral:** No referral was needed, since the claim is on time, shows no possible exclusion and is under a listed coverage. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3" name="Veridia Motor Contract"/> (Article 7)

**Amounts** (from the settlement calculation)

- Payout: €1,200
- Independent assessor required: No
